text:
mira: during a periodic log-scan found a partner webhook secret in plaintext for partner=acme in prod telemetry. value redacted in our copy. need containment and rotation ASAP.
ops-bot: automated-detect v2.0 - 1 match in prod-telemetry. report: https://internal/reports/4300001234 :warning:
sara: paste the redacted line + last-seen timestamp?
mira: `2026-03-23T14:02:15Z INFO webhook delivered partner=acme env=prod webhook_key=****REDACTED****` last seen 2026-03-23T14:02:15Z
security_oncall: treat as suspected compromise. immediate plan: 1) suspend consumers using the key; 2) rotate our secret and ask partner to rotate; 3) deny reads to current Vault path; 4) enable Vault+KMS audit and capture all reads from the window; 5) open incident SEC-2026-25.
leo: storage context: KV v2 path `secret/data/partners/acme/webhook` (version=3). propose writing new secret at `secret/data/partners/acme/webhook-rot1`, generate fresh key, wrap with KMS key `projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/partner-rot`. consumers read fallback-first from rot1 then we retire old path.
sara: rewrap-only is insufficient since plaintext left logs. we must rotate. if partner cannot rotate immediately we should revoke our outbound token and use a short-lived proxy token for outbound requests.
security_oncall: agreed. quick Vault policy to deny old path (will apply immediately if owners ack):
```
vault policy write deny-acme-old - <<'EOF'
path "secret/data/partners/acme/webhook" {
  capabilities = ["deny"]
}
EOF
```
leo: i'll prepare a tiny terraform patch for the policy + k8s roleBinding change to point agents at webhook-rot1 and stage to staging. minimal change to fast-track.
sara: i'll queue the rotation CI job and handle the secret-agent rollout (canary -> full). rotation script (ops draft):
```
NEW_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
vault kv put secret/data/partners/acme/webhook-rot1 key=${NEW_KEY} rotated_by=automation
# encrypt with gcloud kms and update deployments
```
ops-bot: CI pipeline `rotations/partners/acme/4300001234` queued by sara
mira: enable Vault audit device and verify GCP audit sink for partner-rot key. mark affected log buckets for redaction and run detection across retention window post-rotation.
security_oncall: post-rotation checklist: 1) delete or revoke old KV versions from the old path, 2) revoke tokens/service accounts that had access, 3) run full detection across logs and storage, 4) document IOCs and share with partner, 5) close SEC-2026-25 after verification.
sara: task list: sara -> rotation CI + k8s secret-agent sync; leo -> tf + RBAC policy; mira -> partner comms + log redaction timeline; security_oncall -> incident tracking + audit hooks and alerts. I'll keep SEC-2026-25 updated.
mira: please post PoA and pipeline outputs to the incident when done. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
